1. Record the pointer positions while you drag.
2. On release, close the path back to the first point.
3. Fill the polygon with the nonzero winding rule, with anti-aliasing from 4 rows of samples per pixel.
4. Feather the shape when the feather setting is above 0.
5. Combine it with the current selection by the mode.
